proof_attempt_summary: D0 developed the saturated-district common-adversary theorem, a finite feedback-game decision construction, a binary-chain certificate, and an overlapping four-node no-gain instance. The proposed general overlapping-latent boundary remains open, so D0.5 graded the delivered work incremental, below the required field floor. Before reusing local claims, repair the algebraic-coefficient quantifier-elimination reduction and the proof order establishing static cost 2 before invoking the common-hard-model conclusion; neither repair settles the central boundary.
tldr: Can exact population feedback lower deterministic worst-case acquisition cost relative to a fixed identifying collection on one positive fixed-binary independent-edge SCM class? The solved saturated district-response classes admit no adaptive gain, also for fixed nondecreasing collection costs. A finite whole-fiber game decides both costs for each fixed algebraic instance. Exact rational rank certificates show no gain in the prescribed four-node overlapping-edge test. The universal overlapping-edge question remains open.
gap: Static gID design and positive graphical identification do not compare sound adaptive policies with fixed collections on the same interior fixed-binary independent-edge-latent class. Akbari et al. (2025), Section 2.1, use additive vertex costs for a fixed identifying collection; this project deliberately permits arbitrary positive whole-source prices, paid once per source, to represent acquisition or deployment costs that need not decompose across intervened vertices. Ailer et al. (2024) adapt indirect experiments from realized outcomes to reduce an estimator-based query-bound gap. Malek and Chiappa (2021) adapt observational-variable collection to select a formula by cost-adjusted asymptotic variance with finite-sample confidence bounds. Song, Mak, and Wu (2023) sequentially choose experimental units or treatments to reduce posterior variance; Gupta et al. (2021) adapt data-source sampling for estimator MSE. These adjacent objectives leave deterministic worst-case exact complete-kernel acquisition cost unresolved. District responses admit affine-equivalent feedback; overlapping independent latents produce polynomial feedback.
fill: Establish the district-response no-gain theorem for arbitrary positive source-set prices and its positive binary certificate, then resolve the overlapping-edge frontier through a common hard interior model or an exact positive adaptive policy together with a same-class static lower bound. The first test certifies ranks and all relevant rank-equality fibers on the specified four-node graph.
